items.title: 4.8 Potential energy aur kinetic energy ki interconversion (aapas mein badalna) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 4.8 with Figs. 4.12 and 4.13 and Examples 4.5 and 4.6 (PDF 87-89).

blocks.text: Maan lein m mass ki body (jism) Zameen ki surface (satah) se h oonchai par ruki hui (at rest) hai (Fig. 4.12). Position A par us ki P.E. = mgh aur K.E. = 0 hai. Hum body ko chhor dete hain; girte hue dekhte hain ke us ki kinetic aur potential energy aapas mein kaise badalti hain.

blocks.alt: Mass m ka block A par, zameen C se oonchai h par, seedha neeche girta hai. Teer A se B tak x, B se C tak (h - x) aur A se C tak h dikhate hain. Saath likha hai: A par P.E = mgh, K.E = 0; B par P.E = mg (h - x), K.E = mgx; C par P.E = 0, K.E = mgh.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.12: Oonchai h se girti mass m ki body: A, B aur C par P.E aur K.E (kitab ki Figure 4.12 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har jagah P.E. + K.E. jor kar dekhein: A par mgh + 0, B par mg(h − x) + mgx, C par 0 + mgh. Teeno jagah kul mgh hai: jitni P.E. ghatti hai utni hi K.E. barhti hai.
Ab position B par P.E. aur K.E. nikalte hain, jab body x faasla gir chuki ho; hawa ki friction ko chhor dete hain (ignore).
Position B par velocity v_B is equation se nikalti hai:

blocks.text_alt: jahan   v_f = v_B ,   v_i = 0 ,   S = x

blocks.text: Position B par total energy = P.E. + K.E.

blocks.text_alt: Total energy = mg(h − x) + mgx = mgh   (4.19)

blocks.text: Position C par, zameen se takrane se zara pehle, P.E. = 0 aur K.E. = ½ mv_C² hai, jahan v_C yun nikalti hai:

blocks.text_alt: yani   K.E = ½ mv_C² = ½ m × 2gh = mgh

blocks.text: Yani point C par kinetic energy body ki shuru wali potential energy ke barabar hai. Asal mein jab body girti hai to gravity ki wajah se us ki velocity barhti hai (woh accelerate hoti hai), aur velocity barhne se us ki kinetic energy barhti hai. Doosri taraf girte hue us ki oonchai kam hoti hai, is liye potential energy bhi kam hoti hai. Is tarah (Fig. 4.13):

blocks.alt: Girta hua mass m ka block. Pehli jagah (dashed) zameen se oonchai h1 par hai, jahan velocity v1 hai; maujooda jagah par velocity v2 hai aur us ke neeche ke hisse ki oonchai h2 hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 4.13: Oonchai h1 par velocity v1 aur oonchai h2 par velocity v2 wali girti body (kitab ki Figure 4.13 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.text_alt: P.E. ka nuqsan = K.E. ka faida

blocks.text: jahan v₁ aur v₂ oonchaiyon h₁ aur h₂ par body ki velocities hain. Yeh result sirf tab theek hai jab friction ki force na ho.
Agar neeche aate hue friction ki force f bhi ho, to P.E. ka kuch hissa friction ke khilaf work mein kharch hota hai, jo f h ke barabar hai. Baqi P.E. = mgh − f h, K.E. mein badal jati hai.

blocks.text_alt: Is liye   mgh − f h = ½ mv²
ya   mgh = ½ mv² + f h   (4.21)

blocks.latex: \text{P.E. ka nuqsan} = \text{K.E. ka faida} + \text{friction ke khilaf work}
blocks.text_alt: P.E. ka nuqsan = K.E. ka faida + friction ke khilaf work

blocks.text: Ulti soorat mein (jab body oopar ja rahi ho):

blocks.latex: \text{K.E. ka nuqsan} = \text{P.E. ka faida} + \text{friction ke khilaf work}
blocks.text_alt: K.E. ka nuqsan = P.E. ka faida + friction ke khilaf work

blocks.title: Example 4.5
blocks.problem: 1100 kg ki car 12 m s⁻¹ ki velocity se chal rahi hai. Point P par us ka engine band ho jata hai. Agar friction ki force 120 N ho to point Q par us ki velocity kya hogi? Q se aage ruk jane tak woh kitna faasla tay karegi? (Figure: P se Q tak sarak par 24 m, aur Q, P se 1.5 m ooncha hai.)
steps: Point P par car ki kinetic energy ka kuch hissa P.E. mein badalta hai aur kuch Q tak friction ke khilaf work mein kharch hota hai:
K.E. ka nuqsan = P.E. ka faida + friction ke khilaf work
550 kg (144 m² s⁻² − v_f²) = 16170 kg m² s⁻² + 2880 kg m² s⁻²
(144 m² s⁻² − v_f²) = 19050 kg m² s⁻² / 550 kg = 34.6 m² s⁻²
v_f² = 144 m² s⁻² − 34.6 m² s⁻² = 109.4 m² s⁻²
Point Q par velocity v_f = √(109.4 m² s⁻²) = 10.5 m s⁻¹
Q ke baad sarak level hai, is liye ab sari K.E. friction ke khilaf work mein jati hai aur car R par rukti hai: ½ mv² = fS
½ × 1100 kg × 109.4 m² s⁻² = 120 kg m s⁻² × S, yani 60 170 J = 120 N × S

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki aakhri line mein friction force “120 kg m² s⁻²” likhi hai. 120 N force ka unit kg m s⁻² hota hai (kg m² s⁻² energy ka unit hai), is liye sahi: 120 kg m s⁻² × S. Jawab S ≈ 501 m wohi rehta hai.

blocks.alt: Sarak P se Q tak seedhi uthti hai, slope (dhalan) ke saath 24 m, jabke Q P se 1.5 m ooncha hai; Q se sarak R tak level (barabar, seedhi) hai. P se dotted horizontal lakeer aur Q par dohra teer 1.5 m ki oonchai dikhate hain.
blocks.caption: Example 4.5 (PDF page 88): P se Q tak charhai aur phir R tak sarak (kitab ki is example wali tasveer ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Example 4.6
blocks.problem: 3 kg mass ki cheez 15 m oonchai se girti hai. Agar woh zameen se 16 m s⁻¹ ki velocity se takraye, to hawa ki average friction force nikalein.
steps: P.E. ka nuqsan = K.E. ka faida + friction ke khilaf work
v_i = 0 hai, is liye: w h = ½ mv² + f h
3 kg × 9.8 m s⁻² × 15 m = ½ × 3 kg × (16 m s⁻¹)² + f × 15 m
441 kg m² s⁻² = 384 kg m² s⁻² + 15 m × f

blocks.caption: Energy ka hisab
rows: P.E. ka nuqsan = K.E. ka faida: mg (h₁ − h₂) = ½ m (v₂² − v₁²) (4.20)
mgh = ½ mv² + f h (4.21): P.E. ka nuqsan = K.E. ka faida + friction ke khilaf work
K.E. ka nuqsan = P.E. ka faida + friction ke khilaf work (Example 4.5)

blocks.prompt: 200 g ka seb 10 m oopar uthaya aur phir giraya jata hai. Agar uthane ke work ka 75% zameen tak K.E. banta hai to zameen par speed nikalein (numerical 4.10). Jhoole par bachcha 0.5 m se 1.5 m oonchai tak jata hai; us ki sab se zyada speed kya hai (MCQ 4.4)? Kya hawa mein girti body apni kul mechanical energy constant (qaim) rakhti hai (short question 4.3)?
blocks.explanation: Uthane ka work = mgh = 0.2 × 9.8 × 10 = 19.6 J; zameen par K.E. = 0.75 × 19.6 = 14.7 J = ½ × 0.2 × v², to v = √147 = 12.1 m s⁻¹. Jhoola: oonchai ka farq 1.0 m, P.E. ka nuqsan = K.E. ka faida, to v = √(2 × 9.8 × 1.0) = √19.6 = 4.4 m s⁻¹. Nahi: P.E. ka kuch hissa hawa ki friction ke khilaf work mein kharch hota hai, is liye mechanical energy (P.E. + K.E.) f h kam ho jati hai; garmi samet kul energy phir bhi wohi rehti hai.

items: h se girna: A par P.E. = mgh, K.E. = 0; B par (x gira) P.E. = mg(h − x), K.E. = mgx, kul mgh (4.19); C par K.E. = mgh.
Friction na ho: P.E. ka nuqsan = K.E. ka faida, mg(h₁ − h₂) = ½ m(v₂² − v₁²) (4.20).
Friction ho: mgh = ½ mv² + f h (4.21); oopar jati body ke liye ulta. Examples: Q par 10.5 m s⁻¹ aur rukne tak 501 m; hawa ki friction 3.8 N.
